correctness.rationale: The fixed-atom rank-r support is shattered: for each positive T retain those rank-r sets; for each omitted x introduce x\{a} at rank r-1, an antichain incomparable with the retained sets, then extend to a maximal antichain; each omitted x is blocked by its subset. Sperner width bounds every shattered support by C(n,floor(n/2)), giving Theta(2^n/sqrt n) with the attained C(n-1,floor((n-1)/2)) lower bound. Exact n=1..5 maximal-clique/trace recursion, independently implemented in independent_checks.py, gave maximal-antichain totals (2,3,7,29,376) and shattered vectors (1,2), (1,4), (1,8,9), (1,16,55,52), (1,32,285,1090,1780,1224,310). The independent orbit check independently computed all 310 six-supports and 11 S5 orbits of sizes 5,5,10,15,15,20,30,30,60,60,60. The provided ORBIT_CLASSES.json and finite verifier were inspected; no exact n>=6 dimension asserted.
residual_risks: No general exact formula for n>=6 is claimed; finite exhaustiveness is restricted to n<=5.
